persona: Competitor-aware sceptic (knows Shopify POS, Square, Lightspeed and the open-source WooCommerce/Medusa/Odoo tills)

C1.worst_defect: The home page never says who should NOT use this or how it compares with a hosted POS: no line set against Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed, and no 'pick this if / skip this if'. The footer's only comparison is 'For Medusa, see MedusaPOS.' A client weighing it against Square can't tell from the page when this is the right choice.

C2.worst_defect: A known defect is shipped and documented instead of fixed. The changelog says 'Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder, so the till's order history is refused until you add it to the role.' The last release is 2026-10-06, six weeks back, and the hosted till is 'version 0.1.0' against plugin 0.3.0. The demo also shows 'Refund at the till (live demo)' while 'On plugin 0.3.0 the till cannot refund.' To a sceptic, the demo is selling features the installable plugin lacks.

C3.worst_defect: Step 4 hides a trap in a caveat: 'Also add ReadOrder, or the till sells but its order history is refused'. The optional device-key section then repeats that the plugin's own vendurepos-pos-till role lacks ReadOrder, so you must patch the role by hand. Step 5 also carries an unexplained collapsed 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' expander that a new store owner can't act on.

C4.worst_defect: The same ReadOrder caveat appears in quick-start (twice), connect-a-till (twice) and the changelog instead of once, as a fixed step. The changelog reads as internal protocol notes ('order.create v5 … (ADR 0005)'). Troubleshooting says 'The store must advertise order.create v4 and register v1' while the changelog lists versions up to v5, so the reader can't tell which applies.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' is ten identical grey text cards with no icon, image or visual hierarchy. It is the one section that has to out-sell Square's feature grid, and it reads as a wall. The hero till screenshot is small and dense, so the product barely shows at desktop width.

C6.worst_defect: The hero till screenshot is cropped on phone, with the category chips cut mid-word ('Gif'). The inline command 'npx @vendure/create my-shop' breaks across lines in the 'Before you start' list.

C7.worst_defect: Docs pages carry only BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (no TechArticle/HowTo), and Lighthouse flags 52 KiB of unused JS and 120 ms of render-blocking. Everything else is present: llms.txt and llms-full.txt, sitemap, robots, OG image, a real 404, perf 98 and a11y 100.

overall_worst.defect: The plugin's own till role (vendurepos-pos-till) has shipped without ReadOrder in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0, so out of the box a device-key till's order history is refused. The site documents this as a standing workaround in four places ('Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder'), and no fix has been released in the six weeks since 2026-10-06. To someone comparing it with Square or Shopify POS, that reads as an unmaintained pre-release.
overall_worst.where: changelog.desktop.01 / text/changelog.txt; quick-start step 4 and the device-key section
overall_worst.fix: Release 0.3.1 with ReadOrder added to the till role's permissions, and note it in the changelog. Until then, make 'add ReadOrder to the role' a numbered quick-start step and delete the repeated caveats.
